newsitem.title: USA: Citation sees no heavy truck market boon.
newsitem.headline: Citation sees no heavy truck market boon.

text.p: Citation Corp said it does not expect the heavy truck markets to improve in the near term.
The company also said it saw some weakness in the automotive markets in its fiscal first quarter, mainly due to a strike at General Motors Corp.
The company did not say what impact the events would have on its earnings. Officials there were not immediately available to comment.
Citation makes metal parts for the capital goods and durable good industries. The company is based in Brimingham, Alabama.
